rootCause: Reselecting the active object created a new navigation entry.
The shell treated a navigation-key change as an object handoff and unmounted inspector contents.
An unready object replaced the complete inspector frame with a loading message.
changes: Active-object selection and its preview action no longer navigate again.
The shell invalidates inspector contents on a different target object, not a same-object navigation key.
Object loading or failure retains the panel frame and tabs while clearing the old name, counts, contents and preview.
Account/session/object isolation and late-response rejection remain enabled.

regressionBeforeFix.failure: History and attachment list DOM instances were replaced after same-object navigation.

assertions: same-object list identity, request count and scroll preservation

verification.testEnvironmentRetry: The first test invocation could not rename a system temporary cache file and ran no tests. Subsequent checks used an owned D-drive temporary directory.

reviewFollowUp.issue: An unavailable object left the error panel marked aria-busy after loading had failed.
reviewFollowUp.change: Only a pending object load is busy; a settled failure exposes its alert without a busy marker.
reviewFollowUp.regression: The unavailable-object case now requires aria-busy=false; pending-object coverage still requires true.
